backcard_card_name: SS2 Trunks, Envoy of Justice Returns
backcard_card_text:
[Permanent] During your opponent's turn, if you would add a card from your life to your hand or place it in your Drop, you may reveal it and add it to your hand instead.
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card.
[Auto] At the end of your turn, switch up to 1 of your mono-blue energy to Active Mode.
[Activate : Main][Once per turn](Blue)(Blue) : Draw 1 card, then choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and place it at the bottom of its owner's deck. Additionally, if you have a mono-blue Z-Battle Card with an energy cost of 5 or more in play, this card gets +10000 power and [Double Strike] for the turn.
card_text:
[Permanent] During your opponent's turn, if you would add a card from your life to your hand or place it in your Drop, you may reveal it and add it to your hand instead.
[Auto] When this card attacks, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 《Saiyan》 or 《Earthling》 card―both blue and with an energy cost of 4 or less―or 1 blue Unison with a specified cost of 2 among them to your hand, then shuffle your deck.
[Awaken] When a player's life is at 4 or less or a player has 3 or more Z-Energy : You may draw 1 card and switch up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode.
